scope: Current production behavior and ownership boundaries for one explicit Workspace/Assistant session tree. This is a fault baseline, not a completion claim.

identities.owner: Main workspace registry and permission owner
identities.scope: One registered local execution root, assistant binding and permission context.
identities.lifecycle: Survives sessions and runs; removed only by the workspace owner.
identities.prohibitedUse: A session or run identity may never fill a missing workspace scope.

identities.owner: Existing workspace compatibility projection; no independent Project store in this lane.
identities.scope: User-visible work container represented by a transitional 1:1 workspace projection.
identities.lifecycle: Compatibility lifetime only; this lane does not implement independent Project CRUD.
identities.prohibitedUse: Do not add a second Project store or treat equal bytes as type or lifecycle equality.

identities.owner: Existing workspace agent binding and agent registry.
identities.scope: Stable assistant selection within one workspace.
identities.lifecycle: Persists in the workspace binding independently from a physical session.
identities.prohibitedUse: Do not infer workspace authorization or task completion from agentId.

identities.scope: One logical conversation within an explicit agent/workspace context.
identities.lifecycle: Many turns and runs may share it; reset may rotate the physical sessionId without changing lineage by string inference.
identities.prohibitedUse: Not a workspace fallback, run lineage proof or task completion authority.

identities.owner: Runtime session store and transcript/reset owner
identities.scope: An endpoint-specific physical transcript/runtime session generation.
identities.lifecycle: Rotated by sessions.reset; restored or removed by the session owner and its recovery paths.
identities.prohibitedUse: Do not globally rename sessionId to SessionKey or assume it survives reset.

identities.scope: Codex app-server thread or Anthropic CLI session bound to the current execution generation.
identities.lifecycle: Owned by the backend adapter and invalidated or resumed only through that adapter.
identities.prohibitedUse: Configured backend files or historical thread IDs do not prove the actual backend or continuity.

identities.scope: One bounded model/tool turn inside a run.
identities.lifecycle: Terminal status is reported by the turn owner; it is not task completion.
identities.prohibitedUse: A turn result must not be displayed as task or verifier completion.

identities.scope: One execution attempt under an explicit RunScope.
identities.lifecycle: Created for an attempt; retry/continuation relations require execution-owner evidence.
identities.prohibitedUse: Never persist a standalone unscoped run or infer lineage from SessionKey text.

identities.scope: One user-visible task fact for a workspace.
identities.lifecycle: Survives turns, runs and sessions; status changes only through Task Ledger.
identities.prohibitedUse: No second task/goal authority; runtime or browser task IDs are owner-qualified references.

identities.owner: Resource tracker plus terminal, browser and background resource owners
identities.scope: A declared worktree, terminal, browser or background resource attached to a session.
identities.lifecycle: Registered, observed and cleaned by its owning registry; process restart may leave an auditable recovery_required state.
identities.prohibitedUse: Do not introduce a universal session_resources truth table or silently claim cleanup.

actions.label: Turn/run abort
actions.visibleBehavior: Stops the active turn or addressed run without archiving, resetting or deleting the session.
prerequisites: An active turn/run, or a runId that may already be inactive
effects: Block late events from that run in the current generation
inherits: Physical sessionId until a separate reset
actions.successReceipt: chat.abort returns { ok, aborted, runIds }; sessions.abort returns { ok, abortedRunId, status }.

failureStates.known: Invalid scope or authorization rejects with an error.
failureStates.unknown: Transport failure keeps the pre-abort sending state and surfaces an error; a reload is required.
failureStates.unsupported: A backend unable to cancel reports an error; it must not report stopped.
failureStates.refused: No active run is a no-active-run outcome, not task completion.

actions.recovery: Retry with the same SessionKey/runId; load history after an unknown outcome.

actions.label: Session runtime stop
actions.visibleBehavior: Stops runtime activity, queued state and child activity while preserving the session store and transcript.
effects: Release the stop fence on success

failureStates.known: Unknown session or invalid params is rejected.
failureStates.unknown: Fence wait failure is retryable and performs no stop or mutation.
failureStates.unsupported: Missing lifecycle owner is unavailable, not success.
failureStates.refused: Another lifecycle fence refuses the stop without degrading to an agent-wide kill.

actions.recovery: Retry sessions.stop after the retryable drain window; no transcript rewrite is required.

actions.label: Archive conversation
actions.visibleBehavior: Makes a conversation disappear from the live session list while retaining its transcript and restore snapshot.
prerequisites: A runtime lifecycle barrier is required before mutation (not yet enforced by the current production path)
effects: Write sessions.archives.json with the original row and workspace/folder hints
actions.successReceipt: Current Main action returns { success: true } after the rename and archive-index write.

failureStates.known: Missing transcript, unsafe path, or index write failure returns success false.
failureStates.unknown: There is no typed operation receipt or lifecycle fence in the current archive path; a crash can leave a partial local mutation.
failureStates.unsupported: Unsupported runtime backends still share the direct file/index path in this slice.
failureStates.refused: No active-run rejection is currently enforced by the archive caller.

actions.recovery: Inspect sessions.archives.json, sessions.json and the transcript names; A2 must add the canonical lifecycle barrier and retry receipt.

actions.label: Restore archived conversation
actions.visibleBehavior: Brings an archived transcript back into the live list using the saved sessions.json snapshot.
actions.successReceipt: Current Main action returns { success: true } after transcript rename and index removal.

failureStates.known: Missing archive entry or missing archived transcript returns success false; the index entry is re-added on rename failure.
failureStates.unknown: The current code removes the index entry before the transcript rename, leaving a crash window with no retry locator.
failureStates.unsupported: No typed operation identity or lifecycle barrier exists in the current restore path.
failureStates.refused: A live transcript conflict is not represented by a dedicated conflict state in this slice.

actions.recovery: Re-read sessions.archives.json, sessions.json and the two transcript names; A2 must make restore retryable across crashes.

actions.label: Reset session generation
actions.visibleBehavior: Creates a fresh physical session generation for the same logical SessionKey and retires the old transcript.
effects: Drain and fence the old generation
Clear run-bound tokens and non-subagent CLI bindings
doesNotInherit: Old CLI provider bindings for ordinary sessions
actions.successReceipt: sessions.reset returns { ok: true, key, entry } with the new entry/sessionId.

failureStates.known: Invalid session or cleanup failure rejects the reset.
failureStates.unknown: Fence/drain timeout fails closed; the old generation is not mutated.
failureStates.unsupported: Missing ACP/runtime owner may be unavailable and cannot be reported as a fresh generation.
failureStates.refused: Another lifecycle fence refuses the reset without falling back to agent-wide kill.

actions.recovery: Retry through sessions.reset after the lifecycle owner reaches a terminal/retryable state; pre-reset run events must be rejected by generation.

actions.label: Delete conversation
actions.visibleBehavior: Permanently removes a live or archived conversation after runtime/owner cleanup, with no user restore path after success.
effects: For archived entries, use the archive index as a retry locator
actions.successReceipt: Live delete requires deleted=true, matching operationId, journalState=runtime_committed and a non-empty runtime sessionId; archived permanent delete requires every owned derivative sweep to succeed.

failureStates.known: Main session deletion is refused; missing archive entry or incomplete derivative cascade returns success false.
failureStates.unknown: RPC unknown keeps the same operationId and Electron mirror gate; no local sweep is allowed.
failureStates.refused: Main session or unauthorized mutation is rejected.

actions.recovery: Retry the live delete with the same operationId; for archived sessions retain the archive-index entry until all derivatives are gone.

actions.label: Fork conversation
actions.visibleBehavior: Creates a new child session from a source transcript without transferring source task or goal authority.
prerequisites: Fork-point ID, when supplied, resolves on the source transcript
actions.successReceipt: sessions.fork returns { ok: true, key, sourceKey, forkedFromParent }.

failureStates.known: Active source, oversized parent, or unresolved fromLeafId rejects without creating a child.
failureStates.unknown: Gateway unavailable reports failure; no local fork is synthesized.
failureStates.unsupported: Backend lacking transcript fork support rejects.
failureStates.refused: No silent fallback to transcript tip when a requested fork point is unresolved.

actions.recovery: Retry after the source becomes idle or compact a smaller source; never silently switch fork points.

actions.label: Prepare and create handoff
actions.visibleBehavior: Builds a bounded handoff draft and creates a new child session with that draft; the source remains running and unmodified.
prerequisites: Readable context/checkpoint or an explicit bounded draft input
effects: Optionally activate it in the supplied workspace binding
inherits: Workspace/model preferences used for the new session
actions.successReceipt: prepareHandoff returns a draft and lineage; createHandoff returns { success: true, sessionKey, handoffDepth, parent/root ids }.

failureStates.known: Depth, cycle, empty draft, or inaccessible source is rejected.
failureStates.unknown: Gateway/session creation failure reports failure; no source mutation is attempted.
failureStates.unsupported: Missing checkpoint context is reported as unavailable, not fabricated.
failureStates.refused: Handoff policy denial returns a warning/error without moving goals.

actions.recovery: Retry prepare/create after resolving depth or context; never reuse a duplicate handoff creation to claim task completion.

actions.label: Pause scheduled follow-up
actions.visibleBehavior: Disables future Cron/Workboard triggers without aborting an active run, deleting the session, or releasing resources.
prerequisites: Existing Cron job or schedule owner
effects: Persist enabled=false on the schedule owner
Keep the session and transcript intact
actions.successReceipt: cron.toggle sends cron.update { id, patch: { enabled: false } }; the returned job must report enabled=false.

failureStates.known: Invalid job or unsupported delivery patch is rejected.
failureStates.unknown: Gateway RPC failure leaves the previous enabled state visible and must not be treated as paused.
failureStates.unsupported: Workboard/session-generation binding is not implemented in this slice.
failureStates.refused: Pause never implies cancel/abort of an already-running turn.

actions.recovery: Retry the same schedule toggle and re-read the job; use a separate abort/cancel action for the current run.

ownerBoundaries.statement: Workspace remains the execution/permission root; Project is compatibility-mapped and read-only in this lane.
Task Ledger owns user-visible task facts; run, browser, cron and install tasks are owner-qualified references.
SessionKey is a conversation identity; parent/retry/attempt relations require execution-owner evidence.
Renderer operations cross the typed host API and Main-owned transport rather than direct Gateway HTTP/WebSocket calls.
Terminal, browser, background process and worktree resources retain their existing owners; no universal resource truth table is added.
Handoff is a read-only continuity artifact/new draft session; it does not transfer goals, mutate source or drain resources.
Turn, run, verifier and Task Ledger completion are distinct fields and are not inferred from one another.

currentKnownGaps.summary: The production archive path can rename a live transcript without stopping/draining the active session or committing a lifecycle receipt.
Restore removes its archive-index entry before the transcript rename; a process crash can strand the only retry locator.
The historical CodeGraph extension is retired in the current repository; current source discovery used repository search and direct caller inspection.

limitations: No live backend switch, permission revocation, restart or long-running resource measurement was executed for this A1 baseline.
No real-human evidence is claimed; all fixtures and receipts are agent-driven.
Project remains a compatibility projection; no independent Project store or CRUD was added.
The action contract records current behavior and gaps; only A2 and later nodes may close lifecycle mutation gaps.
Shell execution is not a lifecycle API; model tools consume only the scoped existing session tools. Host actions must pass their admission and permission owners.

templateProvenance.use: structure only; source identity and observations regenerated for this worktree

operations.human: Select the existing conversation and send a turn or restore a checkpoint.
Invoke the existing host fork action.
Invoke archive through the host action.
Invoke permanent delete through the host action.
Select a checkout or managed worktree through the workspace/Git host.
Invoke prepare/create handoff through the host.
